TypedStarryControlDescription.One: Only versioned DTOs are sent to deployment-owned instances. Shell, arbitrary command, URL, path, and Docker-socket input are never accepted.

NoStarryInstance.One: No available Starry instance is configured

ReadyHelp.One: Shows whether Kessoku can reach the Starry control agent, the agent can reach the local HBBS control port, and the active configuration loaded successfully. False means configuration changes should stop until the reported error is resolved.

RuntimeStateHelp.One: The state of the configuration currently used by HBBS. Active means it loaded successfully; degraded means service is running with a warning; error means the latest configuration could not be activated.

GenerationHelp.One: A revision number increased after every successful activation. Use it to confirm that the running service has acknowledged the change you applied.

SchemaHelp.One: The format version of Starry's YAML. It determines which fields are understood and validated before activation.

SourceDigestHelp.One: A SHA-256 fingerprint of the active YAML. Kessoku compares it with the file on disk to detect out-of-band edits and prevent overwriting an unseen change.

LastErrorHelp.One: The latest load, validation, or activation error reported by Starry. A dash means no error has been reported since startup.

ProtocolHelp.One: The API contract version spoken between Kessoku and this Starry control agent. Incompatible versions disable operations instead of guessing request fields.

StarryVersionHelp.One: RustDesk Server Starry version reported by this managed instance.

ConfiguredAuthHelp.One: The connection-authentication policy written in the Starry YAML: off, audit (observe only), or enforce (reject invalid connection tokens).

EffectiveAuthHelp.One: The policy actually enforced by the running HBBS. Compare it with Configured auth to confirm the last reload took effect.

VerifierHelp.One: Whether Starry successfully loaded the trusted Kessoku signing keys and can verify connection tokens. Healthy/online is required before switching to enforce mode.

KeysHelp.One: How many Kessoku public signing keys Starry currently trusts. More than one is normal during a planned key rotation.

SchemaDigestHelp.One: Stable digest of the configuration JSON Schema used to keep UI and server contracts aligned.

AuthenticationMetricHelp.One: Cumulative authentication counter for {name}, reported by the Starry control agent.

ConfigDriftDetected.One: Disk/runtime drift detected. Reconcile before applying another change.

InstanceReadOnlyNotice.One: This instance is read-only. Validation and planning remain available; mutations are disabled.

ConfigurationRootMapping.One: Configuration root must be a mapping

PlanMissingOrExpired.One: The plan is missing or expired; create a new plan

OperationSucceededAcknowledged.One: Operation succeeded and runtime acknowledgement was received

OperationNonTerminal.One: Operation remains non-terminal; use its ID to continue investigation

ConfirmRuntimeReload.One: Reload runtime only if disk source digest is still {digest}?

ControlModeReadOnlyTitle.One: This Starry agent is in read-only control mode

ControlModeReadOnlyDescription.One: Status, Relay inventory, YAML viewing and validation remain available. Review plans, apply, rollback and runtime reload require explicitly enabling both the Agent and Kessoku write gates.

ControlModeGuide.One: How to enable controlled writes safely

ControlModeStepOne.One: Back up the active Starry YAML and its signing/TLS material, then test apply and rollback in a staging instance.

ControlModeStepTwo.One: Give the Starry control agent exclusive read/write ownership of the managed YAML and a private 0700 history directory; mount that YAML read-only into HBBS.

ControlModeStepThree.One: Set config.write_enabled: true in control-agent.yaml and server-control.read-only: false in Kessoku, while keeping mutual TLS, service JWT and the local control token enabled.

ControlModeStepFour.One: Restart only the control agent and Kessoku, confirm config_transaction and config_rollback capabilities, then create and inspect a review plan before applying.

ControlModeRiskTitle.One: Write mode can interrupt remote access

ControlModeRiskDescription.One: An invalid routing, authentication or listener change can disconnect clients or lock out operators. Keep out-of-band access, tested rollback history and a recovery copy of the YAML before enabling writes.

AuthMetricAttemptsHelp.One: Attempts is the total number of connection-auth decisions Starry has evaluated since this process started (or its counters were reset). It includes accepted, rejected and audit-only decisions—not login retries by one user.

AuthMetricAllowedHelp.One: Connections that passed token verification and were allowed. In audit mode, traffic that would fail may still be included separately under Audit would deny.

AuthMetricDeniedHelp.One: Connections blocked in enforce mode because a token was missing, invalid, expired, signed by an unknown key, or lacked the required authority.

AuthMetricAuditWouldDenyHelp.One: Connections allowed only because auth is in audit mode, but which would be blocked in enforce mode. Bring this near zero before enabling enforcement.

AuthMetricCacheHitsHelp.One: Verification results served from Starry's local cache without contacting Kessoku again. A hit reduces latency; it is not an authentication bypass.

AuthMetricIntrospectionRequestsHelp.One: Requests Starry sent to Kessoku's protected internal introspection endpoint to confirm token and session state.

AuthMetricIntrospectionFailuresHelp.One: Introspection calls that timed out, failed TLS/authentication, or returned an unusable response. Repeated failures indicate an internal network or trust configuration problem.
